facts.fact: 叙述者（Allie）在 Wünder 的冰冻荒原上被发现时濒死，醒来后发现自己丧失了情节记忆。
facts.anchor: found near-death in the frozen wastelands, and upon waking, had discovered that I had none of my episodic memories

facts.fact: Allie 告诉 Chez，她去 Tulgey Woods 是为了修她给那里安装的早期预警系统。
facts.anchor: I needed to fix that early warning system I’d installed for them.

facts.fact: 公爵夫人从镜中读出邀请函，宣布 Allie 受邀参加今晚的 Grand Ball。
facts.anchor: You have an invitation to the Grand Ball tonight.

facts.fact: Allie 拒绝赴宴，并说自己不该去见他。
facts.anchor: I don’t think it’s a good idea for me to…see him.

facts.fact: 公爵夫人用魔法把一件墨绿色缎面舞裙套到 Allie 身上。
facts.anchor: a tight, deep green bodice of a ball gown, somehow made of the heaviest type of satin and lace

facts.fact: 公爵夫人告诉 Allie，她与国王互换心脏的联结已在许多个月前失效。
facts.anchor: The link between your swapped hearts stopped working many moons ago.

facts.fact: 叙述交代：公爵夫人和 Chez 在国王登基前都是他最老的朋友之一。
facts.anchor: The Duchess, and in fact, Chez too, had been some of the king’s oldest friends before he took the throne.

facts.fact: 数字与时长（逐字）：Allie 自述“All these months later”仍想不起身份、在魔法之地已“nearly a year”；公爵夫人说她“a mere hour ago”刚见过 Chez、Allie 在“these past weeks”无人照管；Allie 说“a few moons ago”她用实验肥料毒了花；叙述说国王“the past centuries”浸淫欺骗与杀戮，心链“many moons ago”失效。
facts.anchor: I know it’s been nearly a year
